description: Free and read-only; never charges. Start here to pick one of the public paid utilities for a job. Returns ranked matches with id, method, URL, price and a one-line summary. Leave task empty to list every utility.

task.description: Plain-language job, e.g. check a supplier company or fix broken JSON. Empty lists all.
